hook: Steer a public Moon so Full lands on the fight that matters, while your Hares wear their neighbours' text.
loop: Bend the Moon with turns and holds; Hares grow each Moonturn.
Waxing and Waning buffs pile up permanent stats across the board.
At Full, Hares borrow neighbours' text and Box for a spike.

growth.line: Permanent buffs every Moonturn, more with extra turns; Full spikes every fourth round; Moonturn doublers take over late.

feel.early: Simple rhythm; small Full spike on turn 3.
feel.mid: Steer the Moon; place Hares beside off-tribe engines.
feel.late: Moonturn multipliers and Full capstones; big swings.

stars.why: Copies the unit on its left at Full; placement is the puzzle.
Turn once, twice or hold: steering the Moon every turn.
Brings Full sooner and gives every Hare a borrowed shape.

card_short.u01: At Full, Boxes the enemy across at Start of Combat.
card_short.u02: Grows each Moonturn while no other Hare is beside it.
card_short.u03: When played, may Turn the Moon.
card_short.u04: Each Moonturn, permanently buffs the unit on its left.
card_short.u05: Moonturn to Waning: get a Leveret in the Form.
card_short.u06: At Full, Borrowed shape: copies its left neighbour's text.
card_short.u07: Holds the Moon; buffs other Hares when it doesn't turn.
card_short.u08: Waxing End of Turn: other Hares gain +2/+2 permanently.
card_short.u09: Can't be attacked with a row-mate; alone, grows and Boxes.
card_short.u10: At Full, Boxes their top attacker; death buffs other Hares.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: buffs units beside it, double at Waning.
card_short.u12: Each turn choose: Moon turns once, twice, or holds.
card_short.u14: Boxes at Start of Combat, again per win; winners grow.
card_short.u15: Shield; copies the text of the enemy across each fight.
card_short.u16: Each Moonturn, other Hares gain +2/+1 permanently.
card_short.u17: Waxing jumps to Full; at Full, other Hares get Borrowed shape.
card_short.u18: It and its two zigzag neighbours share permanent gains.
card_short.u19: At Full, doubles stat numbers in other Hares' text.

builds.name: Full Moon coven
builds.line: Place Changelings right of off-tribe engines; Meikle Care, Moon-Scour finish.

builds.name: Almanac engine
builds.line: Stack Moonturns: Waxwell, Hare in the Moon, Mad March Hare.

builds.name: The Ring
builds.line: Spring Jill, Old Wat and Longshanks Box at Start of Combat.

liked: All three picked Changeling Sister: placement beside off-tribe engines is the puzzle.
A public Moon you steer plays unlike any of today's tribes.
worries: Hare in the Moon engine runs hot: about 270 stats a turn golden.
Also watched: Waxwell, Longshanks, Silverpenny, Three Hares, Moon-Scour; Waxwell's wording unclear.
changed: Three Hares now names its three; Hare in the Moon and Moon-Scour don't stack.
Meikle Care turns to Full without overshooting; Waxwell gets one choice, golden capped.
Borrowed shapes copy printed text only, so copies never chain.
verdict: Close readers who love combos steer a public Moon and borrow neighbours' text for the fight that matters.
